text:
Nora Kim: Need quick alignment: several post-launch UX asks stacking up. Can we gate by MAU impact instead of subjective design preference?
Priya Kapoor: Yes, prefer MAU/activation-first criteria. If change moves activation metric by >1.5% we consider it next-wave priority.
Devon Cruz: Measurement: use cohort activation over 7 days post signup. I'll add a dashboard tile for quick triage.
Alex Morgan: Engineering note: small UX change (button copy, spacing) are low-risk and can be batched into the next minor. Only accelerate if activation boost is expected and quick to implement.
Design-bot: Saved design token `cta-spacing-v2` for review.
Nora Kim: Sounds good. Proposal: quick experiments bucket for UX tests that can be A/Bed in the next minor. If positive, then roll into `next-wave/1.1`.
Priya Kapoor: Agree. Also track design effort estimate and add `design-quick` tag if <= 2 dev-days.
Devon Cruz: Dashboard tile live. We'll check initial signals tomorrow and decide whether any need hotfix-level attention.
Alex Morgan: No hotfixes for design-only unless activation critically broken.
Priya Kapoor: Great. We'll review A/B results at the next triage. Nora will curate the experiments list.
Nora Kim: Will do, thanks.
